title: AI training
intro: Experienced colleagues teach the AI assistant here. Everyone in AI training sees everything here.

gaps.intro: Questions the assistant couldn't answer (well) — without the name of whoever asked.
gaps.checkStarted: Check running — findings land here as open questions.
gaps.checkHint: The AI reads the whole wiki and looks for contradictions, unexplained terms, outdated details and missing answers.
gaps.addHint: Something the assistant should know but doesn't yet.
gaps.questionPlaceholder: The question as a colleague would ask it

training.emptyHint: Start a training and teach the assistant something — by text or file.
training.start: Tell it what the assistant should know, or upload a file (price list, process, email …). The AI checks it against the wiki, asks back and suggests changes.
training.startGap: Answer the question above the way you'd explain it to a new colleague. The AI turns it into a wiki proposal.
training.placeholder: Knowledge, correction or answer … (Ctrl+Enter to send)
training.attachHint: PDF, Word, images, text, CSV — up to 8 MB
training.failed: The answer failed. Send the message again.

proposals.intro: What the AI suggests from the trainings. Only "Apply" changes the wiki or the AI rules — you can edit everything first.
proposals.changedSince: The entry changed since the AI made this proposal. Check that nothing new gets overwritten.

rules.intro: Notes the assistant gets with every answer — for everything that isn't a wiki article: tone, extensions, "for X always point to Y".
rules.hint: Short and unambiguous. Applies to every answer right away.
rules.textPlaceholder: What the assistant should know or keep in mind

people.intro: Who may use AI training. Only admins can grant it.
people.introAdmin: Choose who may use AI training. Admins always have access.
